messages:
Rina (People Ops): @here Heads-up: we27ve updated the Adoption & Surrogacy leave policy and the associated travel reimbursement cap. Effective 2026-01-01. Please read the short summary below and link to the full policy: https://intranet.redwood/policies/adoption-surrogacy-2026

Summary: 1) Leave entitlement: Increase from 10 to 14 paid days (can be taken consecutively within 6 months of placement/birth). 2) Travel reimbursement: up to $3,500 per placement (previously $2,000) for reasonable travel and accommodation costs related to adoption or surrogacy. 3) Eligibility: Full-time and part-time employees with 6+ months tenure are eligible; contractors remain excluded.

Omar (People Ops): Note: managers should submit leave approvals in Workday as usual. For travel reimbursement, employees must upload itemized receipts to Expensify and select the new expense code "Adoption-Travel". Deadline for claims related to 2025 placements is 2026-03-31.

Jules: Quick question 2D if someone previously had a partial reimbursement under the old policy, can they top up the remaining amount under the new cap?

Rina (People Ops): Yes, employees who had a claim under the old cap can submit a top-up request. Finance will reconcile and issue the difference, provided the total does not exceed $3,500 and documentation is complete. Reach out to people-ops@redwood for case work.

Priya (EMEA): For cross-border placements where travel originates from a non-US site, is currency conversion handled by Finance or receipts should be submitted in local currency?

Omar (People Ops): Submit receipts in local currency. Finance will convert using the payment date FX rate. If teams need assistance understanding limits in their local currency, DM People Ops and we27ll provide estimates.

Sam (IC): As an IC on payroll, am I eligible? I27m on the contractor band but paid through our payroll partner.

Omar (People Ops): If you appear in Workday as an employee (PAYROLL record) you27re eligible; pure 1099/agency contractors are not. If you27re unsure, check your profile or DM People Ops.

PeopleOps-Bot: :page_facing_up: Full policy: https://intranet.redwood/policies/adoption-surrogacy-2026 | Effective: 2026-01-01 | Expense code: Adoption-Travel | Claims deadline for 2025 placements: 2026-03-31

Rina (People Ops): Action items: 1) People leaders 2D share this update in your team retro/1:1s; 2) Employees planning or with recent placements 2D submit claims to Expensify with receipts by 3/31/2026; 3) Managers/Finance 2D flag any unusual or high-cost travel for manual review.

Omar (People Ops): We'll post an FAQ and a short explainer card in #benefits and send an all-hands email tomorrow. Ping us for case-specific questions. :sparkles:
